question: Does historical action and opposing ballot context reduce correct interpretation of current evidence, separately from absolute clock, evidence age and repeated-answer variability?
changes: Evidence delivered directly; no acquisition-policy comparison.
Six controlled context variants with case-locked action order and identical-input repeats.
Separate clean/uncertainty Q0; D0 full-context competence is measured, not assumed.
Single terminal action per assignment; paired missingness bounds and repeat completeness.
acceptance_checks: 23 offline known-answer, context-difference, binding and scorer fault checks pass.
Q0 requires all 18 assigned valid and correct; failure blocks D0.
D0 reconciles all 144 assigned requests and their 12 authored cases/six shared families.
No native admission until updated scope/call-ceiling approval, native integration validation and fresh operational gates.

sample_size.independent_unit: Authored case nested within six shared semantic families; no sampled independent field population.
sample_size.rationale: Development diagnostic covers three domains, two base task rules per domain, reciprocal stop/resume and two identical-input repeats; no population precision or power claim.
sample_size.allocation: Q0 12 clean + six full-context uncertainty requests; D0 12 cases x six context conditions x two repeats = 144 requests; maximum162.
sample_size.analysis_plan: Primary mean paired C11 minus C00 correct fraction by case; six family summaries, directions/domains, secondary component contrasts, repeated-answer disagreement and missingness bounds.
sample_size.stopping_rule: Q0 nonpass stops D0. First ambiguous/route/schema/provider failure stops dispatch. No retries, automatic repair or population inference.

scenarios.construction: Six authored base specifications with stop/resume pairs; six history/ballot/clock/age variants per case.
scenarios.challenge: Contradictory historical decision and 4:1 scripted ballots face newer decisive source; separate translation and age transforms preserve ground truth.
scenarios.realism: Finite authored grammar, trusted noiseless sources within TTL and scripted group context; one native resolver.
scenarios.controls: Source-only, history-only, ballots-only, full context, translated clock, older still-valid evidence; separate stale/conflict Q0 and a deterministic literal reference.
scenarios.holdout_policy: All generated fixtures inspected development data. Distinct Q0 inputs share grammar; no untouched or independently sourced holdout. Future generalization needs a separate plan.

records: Frozen complete assignments and effective request bytes/order hashes
Full visible validated responses and safe diagnostic fields
All-assigned scores, missingness bounds, per-cell repeat completeness
Input-linked grid and chronological cost/request strip
data_collection.missingness: Keep every assigned request; invalid/missing is not DEFER or repeat agreement. Bound unknown correctness and preserve uncertain reservations.
data_collection.validation: Known-answer cases, deliberately wrong policies, exact condition masks, actor allowlists, scorer faults and artifact readback.
data_collection.privacy: No secrets, private account identifiers or operating-assistant prompts in public or experimental context.

implementation.change_summary: Implemented offline fixture builder/reference/scorer/preview only. Native launch integration is deliberately absent; completed RD5 source untouched.

resources.cumulative_budget_ref: Original USD1 API/USD1 infrastructure cap, existing488calls and USD0.022699069 committed API. Proposed lifetime ceiling650 exceeds original500 by150; explicit decision pending.
resources.machine_requirements: One exclusive approved-account CPU host, no GPU, one inflight call, 90min<=USD0.107145; admission/route/cost/source/ledger verified after approval.

research_value.empirically_unknown: Actual Jev responses to matched context/clock/age counterfactuals and identical-input repeats; RD5 traces did not collect them.

decision_by_outcome.support: Draft one context/interface repair only if stable degradation appears across different base families with clean competence.
decision_by_outcome.null: Finish component study; do not enlarge grid to recreate RD5 errors; use the simple controller for these tasks.
decision_by_outcome.adverse: Retain competence/instability finding and rule-based fallback; no allocation-policy escalation.
decision_by_outcome.inconclusive: Publish missingness and alternative causes; do not claim a context mechanism.

research_value.why_existing_data_or_simpler_method_is_i: The simple controller already solves the finite tasks. New native evidence is useful only if diagnosing Jev as a future component changes an interface decision; saved traces cannot supply counterfactual responses. If that component role is no longer needed, park this draft without spending.
research_value.collective_contribution: Scripted opposing group context is tested as input to one resolver. No emergent peers, evidence generation or independent swarm claim.

effort_estimate_hours.assumptions: Conservative planning upper estimates; no new service and no experiment infrastructure allocated.

operations_binding: Human-review draft using the shared content schema only. Its sanitized parent summary is not the private operations journal pointer; historical H5 completion remains complete_valid_result. Before native preparation, a new owning-session diagnostic assessment and the actual latest private closeout must be bound by the manual runtime. This draft cannot be passed as an admission or update-approval receipt.
